entries.subject: DAMIT 3870: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 3870, version 2019-05-07, pole (126°, 0°), period 6.58179 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 131.038 ± 1.195 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 131.038 ± 1.195 km, from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 759, 49; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "65.52 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 399, DAMIT model 3870 diameter 152 ± 3 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 3870 fitted to 2 occultations); the shown value is kept.

entries.subject: Agamemnon whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 23 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.902 at 462 nm, 1.064 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#4f4b47 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 7.2% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 1%), from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 759, 49; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
